en:
Harness BLOOD from EYE summons and killing zombies 
 
Use BLOOD to create a mix of a offensive and defensive summons to best the zombie 
horde
 
For info on upcoming waves, hover over the skull wave preview icon on the right

Certain DEMONS have the ability to apply BLOOD BUFFS to other DEMONS. This means that when a compatible DEMON is placed in the BLOOD BUFF area of another DEMON, a special interaction will occur, making the DEMONS stronger.

BLOOD BUFFS are powerful buffs Demons can give to eachother denoted by the red squares around a demon when placing it. Place Demons in eachtothers BLOOD BUFF zones for powerful effects and transformations. Experiment! Or else . . .

Eggwyrms can apply buffs to Occular Spine's, resulting in the Spine having increased health regeneration and the EggWyrm's beam becoming empowered when it passes through the spine.
 
Place an Occular Spine within two tiles to the right of the EggWyrm

Blood Buffs can have powerful effects that shouldn't be ignored. Eyes give general stat buffs to all summons in a one tile radius, while most other summons are more specific. Read up on specific combinations in the CODEX.

Zombies that were once great warriors in life, now granted a sword of hell energy in death, enabling them to deal massive damage.
 
- Slower than regular zombie
- High health 
- High Damage

All encountered Demons , Zombies, and Blood Buffs are documented in the codex.

Check it out now!

SEVERED have had their inner mutation evolve out of control
due to loosing there brains.

Stronger and faster than basic zombies.
Spyders can give MAWS a buff that causes them to release an AOE explosion of slowing webs on death.

SPYDERS provide basic offense
 
They shoot web balls that damage and slow enemies 
 
Click the SPYDER to select it 
Click a tile to place it

SUMMONER Zombies are slow moving masses of flesh that spawn other zombies 
from their putresence. 

Will spawn up to 8 head zombies in an area around it. Make use of attacks 
affecting a large area to take them out.
You have TWO BATTLES to fight. Hit Y to travel to the other dimension also besieged by Zombies. Defend both at the same time!

ZOMBIES will walk right to left down the path, trying to feast on your blood.
 
Use DEMONS to kill zombies before they reach the end of the path. 
 
If too many zombies reach the end of the path, you die.

CHIMERA are the result of the infernal tinkering of Blood Priests. Not content with solely warping human flesh, they fused the bodies of man and demon in an unholy union, creaturing a monster of relentless strength, speed, and ferocity.
HIVE's RECEIVE buffs from SPYDERS, causing slowed enemies killed by Wasps to explode.
When MAW's eat foes inlaid with the eggs of demonic wasps, they absorb and are empowered by the foreign hell energy, gaining increased range.
You will know a BLOOD BUFF is activated by the floating BLOOD around a given SUMMON.

Maws are juvenile apex-predators of Syn, and one highly connected to the ecoystem. The near endless appetites of these creatures fuels their outstanding growth later in life. 

Select one now
Place One Now

Hatchling Wyrms from the Blood Swamps of Syn. Capable of firing a hyper pressurized super-heated beam of blood from their mouths, slicing through prey.

Select one now
Place One Now

An infernal nest of vicious Syn-Wasps, creatures that seek to do nothing but kill and spread.

Select one now
MAW's are ravenous hell creatures that can devour enemies whole. Beware, when all their tentacles are busy wripping prey apart in their cavernous stomachs, the MAW is vulnerable.

Utilize OCCULAR SPINES to block zombies, halting them in their tracks while they attempt to break through. 
 
OCCULAR SPINES will regenerate health over time when not being damaged.
 
OCCULAR SPINES cannot block flying enemies.
 
Click the OCCULAR Spine Icon to select it and place it in a defensive position.
EYES give SPYDERS increased rate of fire.
EYES give HIVES a reduced respawn time for their wasps.

DEMONS can be selected from the Summon Menu in the bottom right
 
Click the Sanguine Eye to Select It
EYES give MAWS the ability to belch out BLOOD when upon zombie digestion completion.
EYES give OCCULAR SPINES increased maximum health and increased health regeneration.
EYES give WYRMS a shorter primary fire cooldown.

EYES generate BLOOD over time. Collect BLOOD by hovering over it with your mouse, but be warned, it will be picked up afterwards for less value if you wait too long.
 
BLOOD is used to place more SUMMONS
  
You also gain BLOOD from killing enemies 
 
Click on a Tile to place the Eye. Be careful, as EYES will get more expensive with each one placed.
LEAPER's can do as their name suggests a catapault themselves over defenses. Take them out quickly.

PHALANX's are severed that use the undead corpses of their kin as a shields that double as battering rams. Masters of hell energy, these foes are not to be underestimated.

Piercing damage is especially effective.
The BLOOD and HELL ENERGY released from the MAW's victims invirogate nearby Occular Spines, enabling them to heal faster.
TICKER ZOMBIES are fast moving sentient bombs. Make sure to take them out before they get too close to your summons.

HIVE's are dens of demonic wasps that can harrass and slow down enemies near itself. Covers more ground and does more damage than the Occular Spine at the cost of durablity. Place wisely.
HIVE's can RECEIVE buffs from EGGWYRM's, enraging the demonic wasps and causing them to attack faster and deal more damage.
The fresh blood dripping from the EggWyrms cocoon can seep into the jaws of a MAW, aiding it's digestion allowing it to kill enemies faster.
A queen Wyrm that can give but not receive buffs.
EggWyrms can simultanesouly buff OCCULAR SPINE's and themselves, granting the Spine increased health regeneration while increasing the Wyrm's damage.

Useful at taking out groups of enemies but struggles against high health single targets.
